overview.headline: Secret summer convention created a new national frame of government

keyPoints.point: Delegates drafted the document in secret during the summer convention
keyPoints.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787

keyPoints.point: Convention convened in Philadelphia to revise the Articles of Confederation
keyPoints.quote: convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation

keyPoints.point: Debate led delegates to draft an entirely new frame of government
keyPoints.quote: rather than amend the existing Articles, the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government

keyPoints.point: Chief disputes involved central power and state representation in Congress
keyPoints.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government, how many representatives in Congress to allow each state

keyTerms.gloss: delegates who met in secret during the summer to draft the new plan

keyTerms.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25
